items.caption:
Presented by @[mention] Fewer than 400 bearded vultures remain in South Africa and Lesotho. National Geographic Explorer Shannon Hoffman has spent over a decade trying to change their fate. By collecting eggs from remote mountain nests and raising chicks through a specialized breeding program, she hopes to raise a new generation that can eventually return to the wild.

Through its partnership with the National Geographic Society and as part of its Perpetual Planet Initiative, #Rolex supports expeditions exploring and protecting remarkable places around the world, a selection of which are featured in #AfricaEarthsWildHome. #PerpetualPlanet

Find out more about bearded vultures at the link in bio. 

Photographs by @[mention]

We’re celebrating 20 years of the National Geographic #PhotoArk, an audacious project documenting the world's incredible biodiversity and highlighting the importance of conservation through photography. Which animal do you want to see next?
